sourceNotes: 新增默认关闭的“Agent 数据”实验性功能
应用音量新增独立开关，关闭后停止应用音频处理并保留音量与输出配置
音频界面与菜单栏根据输出设备显示图标，并在音频页展示已连接蓝牙设备的已知电量
蓝牙设备连接或断开后按需刷新电量，锁屏、休眠或不再需要时停止监听与读取
修复菜单栏手动折叠状态重启后丢失，将入口归入实验性功能并补充系统溢出限制说明
支持从计时弹窗恢复已收起的休息提醒，并完善提醒窗口关闭后的资源释放
优化应用卸载确认与完成反馈，减少选择变化或卸载失败时的误导
改善监控需求减少时的采样衔接，并修复子进程输出收集的调度竞争

en: Add the opt-in experimental Agent Data feature to inspect local storage used by installed AI tools and remove eligible Git worktrees. Tool data is read-only; worktree removal requires individual confirmation and checks for uncommitted content.
Add a separate app-volume switch. Turning it off stops per-app audio processing while preserving volume and output settings; system volume and device selection remain available.
Show device-specific output icons in audio controls and the menu bar, and known battery levels for the connected Bluetooth output on the audio page.
Refresh Bluetooth battery readings on connection changes while needed, and stop observation and reads when locked, asleep, or no longer in use.
Restore the last manually chosen menu bar folding state after restart, move the control to Experimental Features, and explain system overflow limitations.
Allow dismissed rest reminders to be restored from the timer popover, and improve resource cleanup when reminder windows close.
Improve app-uninstall confirmations and completion feedback, including when selections change or removal fails.
Improve sampling transitions when monitoring demand decreases and fix a scheduling race in subprocess output collection.
